explication: Prokka is a command-line tool for rapidly annotating bacterial, archaeal, and viral genomes. The documented workflow takes contig sequences, identifies and labels genomic features, and writes annotation files, including GFF3, GenBank, FASTA, and Sequin formats. Users can select a kingdom and provide curated proteins; installed databases are available for annotation. No source excerpts were provided, so the graph shows only relationships documented in the README, not internal implementation calls.
